name: GitLab
author: GQQI
description: 查询项目、Issue 和合并请求（MR），阅读 MR 改动与仓库文件，并能创建 Issue、发表评论。支持 gitlab.com 与自建 GitLab。

credentials.name: token
credentials.label: Access token
credentials.help: 个人或项目访问令牌。只读用 read_api；创建 Issue/评论需要 api 权限。

credentials.name: base_url
credentials.label: GitLab 地址
credentials.help: 自建 GitLab 填实例根地址，例如 https://git.example.com

tools.name: search_projects
tools.label: 搜索项目
tools.description: Search GitLab projects you can access by name/path. Returns path_with_namespace (use it as 'project' in other tools), description, default branch and URL.

query.description: Text to match in project name or path

tools.name: list_issues
tools.label: 列出 Issue
tools.description: List issues of a project, or across all your projects when project is omitted. Filter by state, labels, search text or assignee.

project.description: group/project path or numeric id; omit for all accessible projects

tools.name: get_issue
tools.label: 读取 Issue
tools.description: Read one issue with its description and latest notes (comments).

iid.description: Issue IID (the number shown in the project)

tools.name: list_merge_requests
tools.label: 列出 MR
tools.description: List merge requests of a project, or ones assigned to / created by you when project is omitted.

scope.description: Used when project is omitted (default assigned_to_me)

tools.name: get_merge_request
tools.label: 读取 MR 改动
tools.description: Read a merge request: description, branches, pipeline status and changed files with diff hunks (truncated). Use for code review.

tools.name: get_file
tools.label: 读取文件
tools.description: Read a file from a project repository at a branch, tag or commit; or list a directory when path is a folder.

path.description: File or directory path; empty for root

ref.description: Branch, tag or SHA (default: the default branch)

tools.name: create_issue
tools.label: 创建 Issue
tools.description: Create an issue in a project. Confirm title and description with the user first.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.label: 发表评论
tools.description: Add a note (comment) to an issue or merge request.
